title: MiguelFaction
description: Addon for migueleconomy. Adds Faction, claim, diplomacy and much more !
body:
MiguelFaction is a faction mod focused on simple group play, shared identity, and team progression. Create your own faction, invite other players, manage members, and build up a shared treasury together.

This beta introduces the first public version of the faction system, including faction creation, invitations, member management, bank actions, and an in-game faction menu. The menu gives players a clean overview of their faction’s name, rank, level, members, claims, and treasury, with dedicated screens for bank, quests, permissions, claims, and member management.

MiguelFaction is designed for servers and survival worlds that want lightweight faction gameplay without overwhelming players with complexity. It works especially well for communities that enjoy building teams, organizing resources, and creating long-term group goals.

This is still a beta release. Core faction features are available, but some menu sections are currently early previews and will be expanded in future updates. Expect balancing, polish, and additional faction systems over time.

Command Summary

/faction
Open the faction menu.

/faction help
Show the main faction commands.

/faction create <name>
Create a new faction.

/faction delete
Delete your faction.

/faction list
Show all existing factions.

/faction owner
Show the owner of your current faction.

/faction owner <faction>
Show the owner of another faction.

/faction members
Show members of your current faction.

/faction members <faction>
Show members of another faction.

/faction invite <player>
Invite a player to your faction.

/faction accept <faction>
Accept a faction invitation.

/faction deny <faction>
Deny a faction invitation.

/faction leave
Leave your current faction.

/faction kick <player>
Kick a player from your faction.

/faction modify name <newName>
Rename your faction.

/faction modify color <color>
Change your faction color.

/faction modify owner <player>
Transfer faction ownership.

/faction bank
View your faction bank balance.

/faction bank deposit <amount>
Deposit money into the faction bank.

/faction bank withdraw <amount>
Withdraw money from the faction bank.

/faction treasury log [page]
View faction treasury history.
